_comment: Manifest for the CLI lab library. One line per lab; the picker, the module pages and the unit pages all read this. `status` mirrors roadmap.md — flip it when a lab ships. Keep slugs identical to the filenames in labs/.

labs.name: Finding the Command Line
labs.tagline: Modes, help, abbreviation, and reading the prompt before you type.

labs.tagline: ip address, no shutdown, and the trap between them.

labs.tagline: Global unicast, link-local, and the one command that makes it route.

labs.tagline: Why you ARP for the gateway and never for the far host.

labs.name: The Eight-Step Sequence
labs.tagline: Walk the sequence in order and let it find the fault for you.

labs.tagline: The U6 mastery gate, on a clock.
